paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : WMT15 De
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for four different methods. The x-axis represents Average Lagging (AL), with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 10.0, marked with tick labels at regular intervals of 2.5. The y-axis represents BLEU scores, with a linear scale ranging from 18 to 28, marked with tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot features four lines, each representing a different method: Consistency-CE, shown in purple with circle markers and a solid line; Inconsistency-CE, shown in dark purple with square markers and a dashed line; Inconsistency-CE-MP, shown in blue with diamond markers and a dashed line; and Consistency-Bi, shown in red with star markers and a solid line. The Consistency-Bi line starts at approximately 22.5 BLEU at 0.0 AL and increases to around 28.5 BLEU at 7.5 AL, before decreasing slightly to about 28.2 BLEU at 10.0 AL. The Consistency-CE line starts at around 18.5 BLEU at 0.0 AL and increases steadily to approximately 26.5 BLEU at 10.0 AL. The Inconsistency-CE line starts at about 19 BLEU at 0.0 AL and increases steadily to around 26.5 BLEU at 10.0 AL. The Inconsistency-CE-MP line starts at approximately 19.5 BLEU at 0.0 AL and increases steadily to around 26.5 BLEU at 10.0 AL.
